task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Use the right arm to lift the smooth ceramic mug, rotate it, and attach it to the rack with angular body after setting it down.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架后，用右臂提起光滑的陶瓷杯，旋转它，放下后将其固定在带有角体的架子上。
